description: PD context-aware self-respawn. Invoked by a PD agent when context window reaches 80% threshold. Saves current state, writes a continuation manifest with all in-flight work and next actions, then stops. The parent session (or user) spawns a fresh PD with the manifest. Enforces max 3 respawns per project per 24h. Invoke when context ≥ 80% during a PD session. Also used proactively at phase transitions when context > 70% and a major task boundary is clean.
